record_timing: Written after mandatory repository, handoff, review-ledger, formal-map, and limited source-triage intake, and before drafting any new A3X claim. The source triage is disclosed rather than backdated.
user_goal: Advance the positive account of bodily/action-related self-feeling from actual organization while preserving the distinctions among experience, intelligence, felt self, conceptual self, and report, and while retaining UCT C1 as a consciousness-specific explanatory postulate.
one_specific_unresolved_question: Can the proposed H_way item be made semantically admissible as a question about the familiar felt character of a presently enacted bodily manner, rather than a covert question about self-source recognition, known practice history, control/agency, or ease; and what exact evidential limit remains even if that content gate is passed?
proposed_addition_or_correction: Add a proxy-substitution stress protocol and a three-layer warrant decomposition: semantic admissibility S_H, independently justified signed judgement-to-experience reliability C_H, and same-instance actual organizational use O_H. Show by a finite lookup-policy witness that passing S_H alone cannot establish C_H; do not add a completed formal node or empirical result.
deliverable: An English research note, machine-readable probe set, claim and gap ledgers, review response, formal-map application audit, validation output, Chinese handoff, and recoverable incremental persistence package.

direction_check.bounded_goal: Only clarify the H_way target and the ceiling of content checks; do not repeat R155 Bayesian calculations or expand into generic control research.
direction_check.return_condition: Stop this auxiliary semantic work once proxy substitution and the non-calibration ceiling are explicit; return to the main line by seeking an independently justified C_H relation and an actual retained-route/congruence contrast.
founding_constraints: No new threshold for basic experience.
No claim that introspection, self-model, report, language, integration, recursion, prediction, or continuation control is required for experience.
No exclusive extra owner and no consciousness verdict about the current assistant.
Complete organization, finite view, abstract model, actual installation, actual attribution, internal judgement, particular experience, and language report remain distinct.
